items.title: Mike Longo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2019
items.q: Man, when I was stationed at Ft. Knox I used to go there and take private composition lessons with Roy Harris.

ctx.x: Yeah. Great story. At that time then, by the time you had done those gigs and you were thinking about college, had you decided on a career in music?

I wanted to not go to college and just play, but my parents really balked at that and so my dad insisted that I go to college. And so my grades went — I was working for some obscure college up in the mountains someplace, and I happened to choose Western Kentucky University. And Cannonball was going, “Man, when I was stationed at Ft. Knox I used to go there and take private composition lessons with Roy Harris.
